title: Notifications
preferences_desc: Select which channel you want to receive each type of notification. The in_app channel (bell) is always active. Only channels configured by the administrator are shown.
no_gateways_configured: No gateways configured. The administrator must activate at least one gateway (Email, Telegram, Matrix, etc.) so you can choose delivery channels. Meanwhile, you will receive notifications in the app bell.
contacts_desc: Your contact details to receive notifications through the different channels. This data is private and not shared.
quiet_hours_desc: During this range, notifications will not be sent via external gateways (email, telegram, etc.). In-app notifications (bell) are always delivered. Leave empty to disable.
digest_mode_desc: Choose how to receive email notifications. Instant sends each notification separately. Daily digest groups all notifications of the day into a single email (at 8:00 AM).
digest_daily: Daily digest (one email in the morning)
webpush_desc: Receive notifications directly in your browser, even when the app is not open. No third parties required - works with the W3C Push standard.
gateways_desc: Configure delivery gateways. Prioritize federated and free networks (Matrix, XMPP, Telegram) over proprietary channels.
webpush_not_supported: Your browser does not support push notifications
webpush_vapid_error: Could not get VAPID key from server
webpush_auto_desc: VAPID keys are generated automatically when a user activates push notifications from their contacts page. You do not need to configure anything here. Just activate the gateway and users can subscribe from their settings.
channel_desc_email: Envia notifications by correo electronico via SMTP
channel_desc_telegram: Bot of Telegram for messages directos
channel_desc_xmpp: Network federated libre - via API HTTP of the server
channel_desc_webpush: Notifications push of the navegador - itself auto-configura, no requires data manuales
channel_desc_sms: SMS via Twilio, Vonage, or API propia
channel_desc_whatsapp: Meta Cloud API or API propia - propietario
channel_desc_webhook: POST HTTP a a URL configurable
field_howto_email_host: It direccion of the server. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com. Outlook: smtp-mail.outlook.com. Your domain: smtp.tudominio.com
field_howto_email_password: Your contrasena or App Password (in Gmail usa App Password, no your contrasena normal).
field_howto_email_from_email: The email that appears as remitente. Must coincidir with your user SMTP.
field_howto_email_from_name: The name that veran them users. Ej: Network Federated
field_howto_telegram_bot_token: The token that you dio BotFather to the create the bot.
field_howto_matrix_homeserver_url: It URL of your server Matrix. If usas matrix.org: https://matrix.org.
field_howto_matrix_access_token: Enters a your account Matrix > Settings > Help & About > Advanced > Access Token.
field_howto_matrix_default_room_id: Enters a it sala > Settings > Advanced > Room ID. Formato: !abc123:matrix.org
field_howto_xmpp_endpoint_url: It URL of the API REST of your server. Prosody with mod_rest: https://xmpp.tudominio.org/rest
field_howto_xmpp_auth_token: Token of autenticacion configurado in your server XMPP for the API REST.
field_howto_xmpp_from_jid: The JID (Jabber ID) of the bot. Ej: bot@tudominio.org
field_howto_sms_provider: Escribe: twilio, vonage, or custom segun the proveedor that uses.
field_howto_sms_account_sid: In Twilio Console > Dashboard > Account SID. Empieza with AC...
field_howto_sms_auth_token: In Twilio Console > Dashboard > Auth Token. Is your key secreta.
field_howto_sms_from_number: The numero that compraste in Twilio. Formato international: +1234567890
field_howto_sms_api_key: In Vonage Dashboard > Settings > API Key. Only if usas Vonage.
field_howto_sms_api_secret: In Vonage Dashboard > Settings > API Secret. Only if usas Vonage.
field_howto_sms_endpoint_url: It URL of your gateway SMS propio. Must accept POST with phone and message.
field_howto_whatsapp_phone_number_id: In Meta Business > WhatsApp Manager > Phone Numbers > ID.
field_howto_whatsapp_access_token: In Meta for Developers > your app > WhatsApp > API Setup > Access Token.
field_howto_whatsapp_endpoint_url: If usas a gateway propio (no Meta), it URL of your API.
field_howto_whatsapp_auth_token: Token of autenticacion of your gateway propio of WhatsApp.
field_howto_webhook_endpoint_url: It URL that recibira the POST. Ej: https://hook.zapier.com/hooks/catch/123456/abc/
field_howto_webhook_auth_token: If your endpoint requires auth, pon the token aqui. Itself envia as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
gateway_help_email_step_0: 1. Necesitas a server SMTP (can ser Gmail, Outlook, or your propio server).
gateway_help_email_step_1: 2. If usas Gmail, creates a App Password in your account of Google (no your contrasena normal).
gateway_help_email_step_2: 3. If usas your propio domain, configura a server SMTP (Postfix, Mailgun, etc.).
gateway_help_telegram_step_0: 1. Abre Telegram and searches the bot @BotFather.
gateway_help_telegram_step_2: 3. BotFather you dara a Token (something as 123456:ABC-DEF...).
gateway_help_telegram_step_3: 4. Copy that Token and pegalo aqui.
gateway_help_telegram_step_4: 5. Each user must start a conversacion with your bot and copy its Chat ID.
gateway_help_matrix_step_0: 1. Matrix is a network federated libre (recomendada). Puedes use matrix.org or your propio server.
gateway_help_matrix_step_1: 2. Creates a account for the bot in your server Matrix.
gateway_help_matrix_step_2: 3. Obtain the Access Token: enters a your account, ve a Settings > Help & About > Advanced.
gateway_help_matrix_step_3: 4. Creates or unete a a sala (room) for them notifications.
gateway_help_matrix_step_4: 5. The Room ID it encuentras in Settings of it sala (formato: !abc123:matrix.org).
gateway_help_xmpp_step_0: 1. XMPP (Jabber) is a network federated libre. Necesitas a server XMPP with API HTTP.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_1: 2. Prosody with mod_rest allows send messages via HTTP API.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_3: 4. Creates a account bot in your server XMPP.
gateway_help_xmpp_step_4: 5. Configura it URL of the API REST and the token of autenticacion.
gateway_help_webpush_step_0: Web Push is configured automaticamente. No necesitas hacer nothing aqui.
gateway_help_webpush_step_1: Them keys VAPID itself generan solas when the first user active them notifications.
gateway_help_webpush_step_2: Only active it pasarela and them users itself suscriben from My contactos.
gateway_help_sms_step_0: 1. SMS requires a proveedor. Recomendados: Twilio (international) or Vonage/Nexmo.
gateway_help_sms_step_1: 2. Register with the provider, create an account and get a phone number.
gateway_help_sms_step_2: 3. Copy your credenciales (Account SID, Auth Token for Twilio).
gateway_help_sms_step_3: 4. If tienes your propio gateway SMS, usa custom with your URL API.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_0: 1. WhatsApp Cloud API is of Meta (Facebook). Necesitas a account of Meta Business.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_1: 2. Registra your numero of telefono in Meta Business Suite.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_2: 3. Get the Phone Number ID and the Access Token.
gateway_help_whatsapp_step_3: 4. Alternativa: if tienes a gateway propio of WhatsApp, usa URL API propia.
gateway_help_webhook_step_0: 1. A webhook envia a POST HTTP a a URL that your configures.
gateway_help_webhook_step_1: 2. Puedes use services as Zapier, Make, n8n, or your propio endpoint.
gateway_help_webhook_step_2: 3. The body of the POST contiene: title, message, link in formato JSON.
gateway_help_webhook_step_3: 4. If your endpoint requires autenticacion, configura a Bearer Token.
